summary.plain: A chamber more than two kilometres inside a mountain in the Russian Caucasus, holding tonnes of liquid gallium metal to catch solar neutrinos.
summary.technical: Underground laboratory of the Baksan Neutrino Observatory, ~2100 m (6900 ft) underground in the Caucasus Mountains, Kabardino-Balkaria, Russia, housing the SAGE gallium detector.
